items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: the piano players of that period like Bud Powell, Al Haig

ctx.x: And then the other thing that always impressed me, the pianist Erroll Garner used to say -- Garner came up in the bebop movement with Charlie Parker and Dizzy and all those guys dominated, on 52nd Street, and the piano players of that period like Bud Powell, Al Haig -- and Dorothy Donzgan was around there, a young kid from Chicago, and George Shearing came from England, and Erroll Garner came from Pittsburgh, and Erroll didn't get swallowed up in that movement like a lot of them did. It was confused. Erroll just…
Before he died, he was the highest priced jazz piano player there was.
